goal: A thesis author can inspect, validate and build one complete bachelor-thesis example offline, while a reviewer can verify the editable DOCX and approved HTML workbench.
non_goals: Do not implement packaging, installation, release or final maintainer handoff before task 009.
Do not add new Markdown syntax or Template Model fields.
Do not build a production PySide6 UI, backend service, account, cloud, market or AI feature.
Do not hard-code school formatting in Compiler or Renderer.
Do not require byte-for-byte identical DOCX archives.
Do not redesign the approved prototype unless fresh verification proves a contract failure.
expected_evidence: Observed RED and GREEN complete-example acceptance tests
Semantic inventory proves all required V1 objects are present
Subprocess inspect, validate and build succeed with network connections blocked and AI credentials removed
Input Markdown, BibTeX, template and image hashes remain unchanged
Generated DOCX passes ZIP, CRC, required-part and XML parsing checks
OOXML proves visible cover content and real TOC, SEQ, REF, Bookmark, PAGE, NUMPAGES, OMML, footnote, section, header and footer structures
OOXML proves real figure media, three-line table, citations, bibliography, acknowledgements and appendix
Repeated builds have normalized semantic equivalence
python-docx reload and LibreOffice DOCX-to-PDF conversion
Rendered PDF page and content inspection
Fresh Chrome desktop/mobile populated and required-state verification output and screenshots
Full pytest, Ruff, pip check and git diff check output
Task report, independent spec review and independent quality review
unsafe_assumptions: A cover section role necessarily renders visible cover content.
Successful validation proves complete semantic coverage.
A valid DOCX ZIP proves required Word objects exist.
Office conversion alone proves acceptable sensory output.
Static prototype markup alone proves mobile behavior and interactive states.
Existing screenshots are fresh evidence for the current prototype.
stop_condition: Stop if work leaves the allowlist, requires new syntax or template fields, hard-codes school formatting, substitutes text for real Word objects, cannot reproduce Office/browser evidence, or expands into task 009.
